change: During OriginalMacRuntimeLoading.replay of a committed gameplay batch, on hosts that present concurrently (headless, Android), front fill/copy/flip validate and change metadata on the main thread and queue their pixel work, crop and present on one serial render thread (RenderExecutor); closures hold only Storage objects and values (CopyPlan). At most one batch is in flight (replay flushes first); every other display entry point, window observation, capture and exit flushes; a failed present check applies the pixels first and throws at the same draw. AppKit, iOS and SDL stay synchronous; --synchronous-render turns it off. Android keeps frame, surface and geometry in a locked target; touches map with the window and size recorded on the main thread.
